reviews.t: ... used to a "creamier" tinted moisturizer This goes on nicely, doesn't streak
reviews.x: I am used to a "creamier" tinted moisturizer  This goes on nicely, doesn't streak, and looks good, just the right amount of tint.  I am 64 y.o., I have rosacea and freckled skin, and it's been 5 days since I started using it and so far, I have had no burning or flare ups.  I would recommend it.

I love the light color that the cream gives my face.  I live in a northern state where we receive much less sun during our winter months.  Thus, I gradually become more and more pale in the winter.  This product not only gives my face some much needed moisture, it also gives me some much needed color.  The color is a nice, gentle glow  - not orange or fake looking.  I received this product to review and I am very pleased with it.

Andre Lorent's Tinted Moisturizer Cream, SPF 15, Best for Light, Fair & Sensitive Skin, With Vitamins B, C & E, goes on smoothly and beautifully. I apply it by starting from the neck up, so that I don't pull my tender facial skin down. The color is phenomenal--it is very soft and light, almost luminous. It is SUPER that this product has an SPF of 15 so that you can use it during the day and have great protection for your skin--I love that aspect of it. As I have aging, sensitive skin, I need exa

I was a little taken aback when first putting it on my face, as it is quite yellow. But after smoothing it all over, it gives a light glow and dewy look. This is putting a very small amount on and dabbing it in. I am 66 years old and wanted a light fresh look to my skin. I love it!

My husband received this at a reduced price. I'm not that impressed. It doesn't feel as creamy as other brands I've tried and it was difficult to blend.  It does look ok after it's blended and my face feels soft but I'm not sure it's worth the effort. I tried blending with a sponge but it worked better using my fingers. I then had orange fingers. Overall it's just ok.

reviews.t: Great for moisturizing, blending,  and SPF.
reviews.x: This moisturizer is proving itself to be great for me this summer!  It blends well,  which may surprise you when you see the tint in it,  but it truly blends in to your skin tone.  I have used this brand before and I like this one even better. Besides moisturizing and blending, it provides a healthy glow and SPF protection.

I've been using a tinted moisturizer that was discontinued AND very expensive. When I saw this product and the price I figured I should try it. So glad I did. Covers well with small amount, keeps all day, and inexpensive compared to what I was paying. Win...win...win situation in my book!

Would love to love it...unfortunately at 50 yrs old I STILL have oily skin and after using this product my skin was disgusting and even more greasy after just a couple of hours.  The tint was fine though.

reviews.t: for the cost and the poor sun blockage I will consider another
reviews.x: It doesn't feel oily, light bronzing. Don't cover very much, for the cost and the poor sun blockage I will consider another product

reviews.t: Color is great for fair skinned people Love this product Thanks
reviews.x: Very light on the face does not cake feels real smooth . Color is great for fair skinned people Love this product Thanks, Anne C

reviews.t: Very light and soft, I wish it was available with a higher SPF
reviews.x: First of all, you have to know that I am the kind of person whose "makeup routine" is add moisturizer to a clean face, eyeliner and mascara and lip balm. I never go for the layers of concealer, foundation, powder, etc. That being said, I do appreciate the benefits of a good BB cream or in this case, the tinted moisturizer. It is kind of creamy when you squeeze it from the containter, similar to a regular makeup product, but when you apply it to your face it feels really light, not at all

I received the product very quickly as always with Amazon. I was super excited to try it out. The first thing I noticed was the smell, it smelled great! I used a sponge to apply it, although I am sure you could use your fingers. It goes on really smooth and doesn't feel heavy like some other moisturizers I have tried. I loved how smoothly my make up went on over it. After using it for a few days I decided to not use it for a day just to see if I noticed a difference and boy did I. My make up did

I have tried a lot of differnt tinted moisturizers, so I'd like to think that I know what I am looking for by now. This product has it all. It blurs imperfections, covers evenly and smoothly, absorbs quickly, and does not affect the rest of my make-up route. Some tinted moisturizers tend to flake a little when appling a liquid make-up primer on top of them. As long as you allow it to dry, this one has no problem with the addition of primers, foundation and/or powders. I cannot attest to the anti

I love this tinted moisturizer cream. I have been using it for a week now and find it has a silky feel when applied and evens out my skin, covering pores and discolorations beautifully. You will not even know you have it on! What is even more fascinating to me is that I have a sun tan and it is supposedly for fair, light skin, and yet it works for me. That goes with how silky it is. I highly recommend this for all you gals who are looking for that perfect product for your face at a reasonable co

reviews.t: It took almost a week for my face to become hydrated enough to really enjoy this cream
reviews.x: I had no idea that my face was so dry. It took almost a week for my face to become hydrated enough to really enjoy this cream.  My skin is softer now than it has been in years,  I used to be a sunbather. The tint is not streaky or orange.  My husband didn't even notice, unlike the other tinted creams I have used. I am extremely happy with how my skin is reacting to this product and would not hesitate to recommend it to a friend. People have asked me how I am feeling' because I am looking so good

The product is very thick, but the ebook that's sent with it explains that it will be, so this was not a surprise. Since it's so thick, it really gives my face a finished look. I have oily skin, so I was concerned that it might make me break out, but this hasn't been the case at all. My skin doesn't feel greasy, and this product works well as a kind of primer for my mineral-powder foundation.The tint is subtle, but just enough on my very pale skin to give me some much-needed color and glow.

reviews.t: I will be using this on a daily basis!
reviews.x: I've only had the product for a few days, but I can honestly say that I am in love with this! It doesn't feel heavy, yet it does give nice coverage to my uneven skin tone and brown spots.  So much better than foundation or mineral powder (which I hate to use in the summer), and it seems to last much longer through the day than other tinted moisturizers I've used.  It leaves my skin feeling very soft and it smells nice, too. :)

I love this product.  I have sensitive skin but this worked great from day one.  Just like the other reviews I read it did go on and look a little yellow but blended perfectly. I have been using it for six months and it looks like I will not have to re-order for at least another month.  You only need a small amount. Great value, great product.  It is so refreshing when something is as advertised.  Thank you!

This was an ok product but not really for me. Seemed more like a foundation than a tinted moisturizer/sunscreen. The color was way off for my light skin. Very yellow/olive and didn't blend well. The product was not greasy at all going on but with even a small amount of sweat it turned very greasy and streaky. While it may work for someone else with a different complexion it just didn't work for me.

Another fabulous product, I have tried almost everything Andre Lorent makes and I have loved every product. This tinted moisturizer gives my skin a nice glow and makes my face feel amazing!!! I am going to buy more of these as gifts this year for friends and family. A little of this product goes a long way too! Definite must buy item in the beauty world!!!

reviews.t: I am so glad I tried this product
reviews.x: I am so glad I tried this product. I have very sensitive skin and I am always trying to find something I can use. I have been using it a week and have already had great results. It does exactly what they say it does. Evened out my skin tone and my skin feels fantastic. I ordered this product on a discount but I would gladly pay full price. AMAZING stuff.

This moisturizer seems great! I've been using it for about a week and so far love it. It's lightweight, which I really like, as some moisturizers seem really heavy to me. Also I really like the subtle tint to it, it blends right in with my skin tone. I don't typically wear a lot of makeup so I love the little bit of color it adds.

reviews.t: Overall the product is nice, the color is too yellow for my skin ...
reviews.x: Overall the product is nice, the color is too yellow for my skin but the hydration is nice. If they made one in a less yellow/fairer completion color I would but again. The container is nice as it's pump compared to having to squeeze a bottle and you get all of the product out instead of having tons stuck in the container.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the light, smooth application and natural glow, saying it blends well and doesn't feel heavy or cakey.
Many reviewers with fair or sensitive skin find the tint and color flattering and suitable for their skin tone.
Several reviewers appreciate the moisturizing benefits and good value for the price.
A few reviewers find the texture not creamy enough and difficult to blend, requiring extra effort.
Some reviewers report issues with greasiness on oily skin or insufficient coverage and sun protection for the cost.
